hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.name: FileUpload
hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.doc: Props: accept, multiple, maxSize (bytes), maxFiles, upload(file, { onProgress(fraction|{loaded,total}), signal }) → Promise<result>, label (drop zone text). Value: without `upload` the File (or File[] with multiple); with `upload` the result(s). onError(message, file) is called for rejected files.

props.name: accept
props.doc: "image/*,.pdf"

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Bytes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Drop zone text.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The small line under the drop text ("image/* · max 5 MB"): `false` removes it, a node / text / `() => node` replaces it.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Image thumbnails and audio players of the chosen files: `false` shows only names.

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: Content of the remove button of a file instead of the "×" (a node, text or `() => node`).

props.name: labels
props.type: { /** "max 5 MB" in the hint. */ max?: ((size: string) => string) | undefined; /** "Uploaded" next to a finished file. */ uploaded?: unknown; /** "Cancel" on the button of a running upload. */ cancel?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the progress bar. */ uploading?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; /** Accessible name of the cancel button. */ cancelUpload?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; /** Accessible name of the remove button of a file. */ remove?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; /** Rejection messages (also passed to onError). */ typeNotAllowed?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; tooLarge?: ((name: string, max: string) => string) | undefined; tooMany?: ((max: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Every other text the control writes; each default is the built-in (translated) text.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#FileUpload.tr: Prop'lar: accept, multiple, maxSize (bayt), maxFiles, upload(file, { onProgress(fraction|{loaded,total}), signal }) → Promise<result>, label (bırakma alanı metni). Değer: `upload` yoksa File (multiple ile File[]); varsa yükleme sonucu.

hadi-march/ui#filterFonts.name: filterFonts
hadi-march/ui#filterFonts.doc: Narrow and order families: text (accents and case folded; names that start with it first), category, subset, sort.
hadi-march/ui#filterFonts.signature: function filterFonts(list: readonly FontFamily[], f: FontFilter): FontFamily[]
hadi-march/ui#filterFonts.tr: Aileleri daraltır ve sıralar: metin (büyük/küçük harf ve aksan yok sayılır; adın başında eşleşenler önce), tür, alfabe, sıralama.

hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.name: firstDayOf
hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.doc: First day of week for a locale (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday); Monday when Intl has no week info.
hadi-march/ui#firstDayOf.tr: Bir dil için haftanın ilk günü (0 = Pazar … 6 = Cumartesi); Intl hafta bilgisi vermiyorsa Pazartesi.

hadi-march/ui#FollowButton.name: FollowButton

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the next state (follow → following, or requested when `private`; back to follow).

props.name: private
props.doc: A private account: following asks first.

props.name: name
props.doc: Whom (accessible name: "Follow HADİ").

props.name: block
props.doc: Stretch to the container.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Your own button texts: `{ follow: "Join", following: "Member", requested: "Waiting" }` (any subset).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.type: ((state: FollowState, name: string | undefined) => string) | undefined
props.doc: Your own accessible name: `(state, name) => "…"`. Default: "Follow HADİ", "Following HADİ, press to unfollow"…

props.name: icon
props.doc: The + / tick / clock icon: true (default), false, or `(state) => node`.

props.name: burst
props.doc: The burst of dots on a new follow. Default true.

props.name: morph
props.doc: The width spring and the icon turn between states. Default true.

hadi-march/ui#FollowButton.tr: `<FollowButton state={$state} name={user.name} onChange={(s) => $state = s} />` — takip düğmesi.

hadi-march/ui#FONT_CATEGORIES.name: FONT_CATEGORIES
hadi-march/ui#FONT_CATEGORIES.doc: The font categories, in the order the picker shows them.
hadi-march/ui#FONT_CATEGORIES.tr: Yazı tipi türleri, seçicideki sırayla: sans-serif, serif, display, handwriting, monospace.

hadi-march/ui#FontPicker.name: FontPicker
hadi-march/ui#FontPicker.doc: Font picker: `<FontPicker bind:value={$font} />`. The value is the family name; `onPick` gives the CSS stack, the weight and the stylesheet.

props.name: view
props.doc: How the picker shows: "popover" (default: a panel by its button), "dialog" (a window), "inline" (the panel itself).

props.name: system
props.doc: Fonts of the device: true (default: the built-in list), false, or your own families (`source: "system"`, `stack`).

props.name: catalog
props.type: false | readonly FontFamily[] | (() => Promise<readonly FontFamily[]>) | undefined
props.doc: Web fonts: the built-in Google Fonts catalog (default, loaded when the picker first opens), your own families, a function that loads them, or false.

props.name: source
props.doc: Where web fonts are loaded from: "google" (default), the address of your own server that answers `/css2?family=…`, a function `(request) => stylesheet address`, or false (never load).

props.name: askConsent
props.doc: Ask before the first request to the font source (it sees the visitor's address); the answer is remembered. Default false.

props.name: onPick
props.doc: Every pick and every change of weight / italic, with the CSS to use the font.

props.name: weight
props.doc: Weight chosen at first (default 400; the family's nearest weight is used).

props.name: italic
props.doc: Italic at first.

props.name: load
props.doc: Load the picked web font into the page before the value changes (default true); false: you load it (`onPick` gives `url`).

props.name: preview
props.doc: What a row draws in its type: "name" (default) or "sample" (the sample text, the name under it).

props.name: sample
props.doc: The sample text of the specimen (and of the rows with `preview="sample"`).

props.name: onSample
props.doc: The sample text was edited.

props.name: category
props.doc: Category shown at first / followed when it changes ("all" by default).

props.name: sort
props.doc: Order: "popular" (default), "name", "newest".

props.name: subset
props.doc: Only families with this subset ("latin-ext", "cyrillic", "arabic"…); "all" by default.

props.name: search
props.doc: The search field (default true).

props.name: categories
props.doc: The category switcher: true (default), false, or the categories to offer.

props.name: sorts
props.doc: The order switcher: true (default), false, or the orders to offer.

props.name: subsets
props.doc: The subset list: true (default: every subset of the catalog), false, or the subsets to offer.

props.name: favorites
props.doc: Favourites: the star on each row, the Favourites group and the "only favourites" filter (default true).

props.name: onFavorite
props.doc: A star was pressed.

props.name: recent
props.doc: Recent picks kept in their own group (default 5; 0: none).

props.name: specimen
props.doc: The specimen: the chosen font with your sample text, size, weight, italic and the CSS (default true).

props.name: sizeControl
props.doc: In the specimen: the size slider (default true).

props.name: styleControls
props.doc: In the specimen: weight and italic (default true).

props.name: css
props.doc: In the specimen: the `font-family` line with a copy button (default true).

props.name: meta
props.doc: The second line of a row: category and number of styles (default true).

props.name: count
props.doc: How many families match, next to the filters (default true).

props.name: deviceFonts
props.doc: "Fonts on this device" where the browser can list them (asks the visitor; default true).

props.name: closeOnPick
props.doc: Close the popover / dialog after a pick (default false: weight and italic can still be set).

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: Where favourites, recent picks and the consent are remembered (default "fonts"); false: only while the page is open.

props.name: open
props.doc: Open state of the popover / dialog (yours); without it the picker keeps its own.

props.name: trigger
props.type: unknown | ((api: { toggle(): void; open(): void; close(): void; font(): FontFamily | undefined }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Your own button: a node, or `(api) => node` with `api.toggle()`, `api.font()`. Default: a button with the name in its type.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the default button.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the popover opens (default "bottom-start").

props.name: motion
props.doc: Entrance of the popover / dialog: "scale" (default), "fade", "rise", "none".

props.name: renderRow
props.type: ((font: FontFamily, state: { selected: boolean; favorite: boolean }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Draw the inside of a row yourself.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Shown when nothing matches: text or a node (default "No fonts match").

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts.

props.name: panelClass
props.doc: Class of the panel (the popover, the dialog body or the inline box).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#FontPicker.tr: Yazı tipi seçici: `<FontPicker bind:value={$font} />`. Değer aile adıdır; `onPick` CSS yığınını, kalınlığı ve stil dosyasının adresini verir.

hadi-march/ui#fontStack.name: fontStack
hadi-march/ui#fontStack.doc: The CSS `font-family` value of a family: its own stack, or `"Name", <generic of its category>`.
hadi-march/ui#fontStack.signature: function fontStack(font: Pick<FontFamily, "family" | "category"> & { stack?: string | undefined }): string
hadi-march/ui#fontStack.tr: Bir ailenin CSS `font-family` değeri: kendi yığını ya da `"Ad", <türünün genel ailesi>`.

hadi-march/ui#fontUrl.name: fontUrl
hadi-march/ui#fontUrl.doc: The stylesheet address of a request at a source, or null (no source, a system font). `/css2` syntax of Google Fonts.
hadi-march/ui#fontUrl.signature: function fontUrl(source: FontSource | undefined, req: FontRequest): string | null
hadi-march/ui#fontUrl.tr: Bir isteğin kaynaktaki stil dosyası adresi; kaynak yoksa null. Google Fonts'un `/css2` sözdizimi.

hadi-march/ui#Form.name: Form
hadi-march/ui#Form.doc: Form. Auto-renders every active schema field, or your children (reach the controller with useFormContext()). Props: schema, initial, onSubmit, validateOn, form (an existing useForm), submitLabel, cancel (true = reset, or fn), cancelLabel, layout ("stack" | "grid"), cols, sections [{ title, description, fields }], actions (false hides the bar), confirmLeave, requireDirty, readonly, onReady(form), class.

props.name: form
props.doc: An existing useForm() controller.

props.name: cancel
props.doc: true = reset, or a function.

props.name: actions
props.doc: false hides the submit bar.

hadi-march/ui#Form.tr: Form. Etkin her şema alanını ya da alt öğelerinizi otomatik çizer (denetleyiciye useFormContext() ile erişin). Prop'lar: schema, initial, onSubmit, validateOn, form (mevcut bir useForm), submitLabel, cancel ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#FormActions.name: FormActions
hadi-march/ui#FormActions.doc: Submit / cancel bar with the submit error.

props.name: cancel
props.doc: true = reset, or a function.

props.name: requireDirty
props.doc: Disable submit until something changed.

props.name: extra
props.doc: Extra buttons before cancel / submit.

hadi-march/ui#FormActions.tr: Gönderim hatasını da gösteren gönder / vazgeç çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#format.name: format
hadi-march/ui#format.doc: RGBA → "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa", "rgb(r g b / a)" or "hsl(h s% l% / a)".
hadi-march/ui#format.signature: function format(c: Rgba, f: ColorFormat = "hex", hue?: number): string
hadi-march/ui#format.tr: RGBA → "#rrggbb" veya "#rrggbbaa", "rgb(r g b / a)" ya da "hsl(h s% l% / a)".

hadi-march/ui#FORMAT_KEYS.name: FORMAT_KEYS
hadi-march/ui#FORMAT_KEYS.value: { bold: "Control+B", italic: "Control+I", strike: "Control+Shift+X", code: "Control+E", link: "Control+K", ol: "Control+Shift+7", ul: "Control+Shift+8", quote: "Control+Shift+9" }

hadi-march/ui#FORMAT_TOOLS.name: FORMAT_TOOLS
hadi-march/ui#FORMAT_TOOLS.doc: Tools FormatToolbar shows when `tools` is not given, in order.

hadi-march/ui#formatCount.name: formatCount
hadi-march/ui#formatCount.doc: The text of a count. `"compact"` (default): short from a thousand on ("1.2K", tr "1,2 B"); `"full"`: every digit; an object: Intl formatting (`{ format: { style: "percent" }, decimals: 1 }`) in `loc` (default: the active locale).
hadi-march/ui#formatCount.signature: function formatCount(n: number, format: "compact" | "full" | CountFormat = "compact", loc?: string): string
hadi-march/ui#formatCount.tr: Bir sayının metni: `formatCount(1234)` → "1,2 B" (tr) / "1.2K" (en); "full" her basamağı yazar, `{ format, decimals }` nesnesi Intl seçenekleriyle (para, yüzde) biçimlendirir.

hadi-march/ui#formatDate.name: formatDate
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.doc: Format an ISO date for typing (numeric, locale order).
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.signature: function formatDate(iso: unknown, loc?: string): string
hadi-march/ui#formatDate.tr: ISO tarihini yazım için biçimlendirir (sayısal, dilin sırasıyla).

hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.name: formatNumber
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.doc: Format a number for an input (no grouping by default so it stays easy to edit).
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.signature: function formatNumber(n: number | null | undefined, loc?: string, __2: FormatNumberOptions = {}): string
hadi-march/ui#formatNumber.tr: Bir sayıyı girdi için biçimlendirir (düzenlemesi kolay kalsın diye varsayılan olarak gruplama yok).

hadi-march/ui#formatShortcut.name: formatShortcut
hadi-march/ui#formatShortcut.doc: The tool of a formatting shortcut: mod+B / I / E / K, mod+Shift+X / 7 / 8 / 9. Undefined for any other key.
hadi-march/ui#formatShortcut.tr: Bir biçimlendirme kısayolunun aracı: mod+B / I / E / K, mod+Shift+X / 7 / 8 / 9. Başka tuşta undefined.

hadi-march/ui#FormatToolbar.name: FormatToolbar
hadi-march/ui#FormatToolbar.signature: function FormatToolbar<T extends FormatTool = FormatTool>(props: FormatToolbarProps<T>): Element

props.name: tools
props.doc: Tools in order; "|" draws a separator (default FORMAT_TOOLS). Read once: re-create the bar for another list.

props.name: onTool
props.doc: Runs a tool (your editor applies the format).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the toolbar (default "Formatting").

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own names: a text per tool (`{ bold: "Strong" }`); the translated one otherwise.

props.name: name
props.doc: Own name of a tool as a function (read live); wins over `labels`.

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own icons: an icon, a text or a node each; `false` draws none.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: Toggle tools: an accessor per tool that can be "on" (sets `aria-pressed` and the pressed look).

props.name: keys
props.doc: Shortcuts for `aria-keyshortcuts` ("Control+B"); FORMAT_KEYS are there already, `false` removes one.

props.name: hints
props.doc: The shortcut in the tooltip too: "Bold (Ctrl+B)" (default false: the name alone).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the buttons (default "sm").

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Class prefix of a host that keeps its own class names ("m-mde"): the bar is also `<prefix>-toolbar`, a button `<prefix>-tool`, a separator `<prefix>-sep`, an own icon `<prefix>-tool-own`.

props.name: attrs
props.doc: Extra attributes of a tool's button (`aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `class`, `ref` …).

hadi-march/ui#FormatToolbar.tr: Metin editörünün biçimlendirme çubuğu: araçlar ve sıraları, adlar, ikonlar, kısayol ipuçları, basılı durum sizin; tek sekme durağı: `<FormatToolbar tools={["bold", "italic", "|", "link"]} onTool={exec} hints />`.

hadi-march/ui#FormContext.name: FormContext
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.doc: The enclosing form (provided by useForm's <Form>, a wizard step…).
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.signature: const FormContext: { id: symbol; defaultValue: FormController | null }
hadi-march/ui#FormContext.tr: Çevreleyen form (useForm'un <Form>'u, bir sihirbaz adımı vb. sağlar).

hadi-march/ui#frame.name: frame
hadi-march/ui#frame.doc: Build a modal frame (overlay + panel). Must run inside an owner; the frame unregisters and restores focus on cleanup.
hadi-march/ui#frame.tr: Kipli bir çerçeve kurar (örtü + panel). Bir sahip içinde çalışmalı; temizlikte çerçeve kaydını siler ve odağı geri verir.

hadi-march/ui#frameSize.name: frameSize
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.doc: The frame (fw × fh px) in a view of vw × vh px for a state: aspect-fitted, centered.
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.signature: function frameSize(st: CropState, vw: number, vh: number): [number, number]
hadi-march/ui#frameSize.tr: Bir durum için vw × vh px görünümdeki çerçeve (fw × fh px): en-boy oranına sığdırılmış, ortalanmış.

hadi-march/ui#freeKey.name: freeKey
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.doc: A key not used in `obj`: base, base2, base3 …
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.signature: function freeKey(obj: Record<string, unknown>, base: string = "key"): string
hadi-march/ui#freeKey.tr: `obj` içinde henüz kullanılmayan bir anahtar üretir: base, base2, base3 sırasıyla.

hadi-march/ui#getAt.name: getAt
hadi-march/ui#getAt.doc: Value at a path (array of keys / indexes) inside a JSON value, or undefined.
hadi-march/ui#getAt.signature: function getAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath): unknown
hadi-march/ui#getAt.tr: Bir JSON değeri içindeki yoldaki (anahtar / indeks dizisi) değer, yoksa undefined.

hadi-march/ui#googleFonts.name: googleFonts
hadi-march/ui#googleFonts.doc: The built-in Google Fonts catalog (about 1,900 open-licensed families): its own lazy part, loaded once.
hadi-march/ui#googleFonts.tr: Yerleşik Google Fonts kataloğu (yaklaşık 1.900 açık lisanslı aile): kendi tembel parçası, bir kez yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.name: gradientCss
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.doc: CSS of a gradient (stops sorted by position).
hadi-march/ui#gradientCss.tr: Bir gradyanın CSS'i (duraklar konuma göre sıralanır).

hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.name: GradientEditor
hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.doc: Gradient editor: `<GradientEditor bind:value={$css} />`. The value is a CSS gradient.

props.name: types
props.doc: Types offered (default linear, radial, conic).

props.name: presets
props.doc: Preset gradients: a CSS gradient or a list of colors / theme tokens. Default: HADİ and theme gradients; false hides them.

props.name: output
props.doc: The CSS output with a copy button (default true).

props.name: preview
props.doc: The large preview on top (default true).

props.name: dial
props.doc: The angle dial (default true).

props.name: angles
props.doc: Quick angle buttons: default 0 to 315 in steps of 45; your own list; false hides them.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The hint under the stop bar (default true).

props.name: position
props.doc: The position field beside the color picker of the selected stop (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; type?: string; linear?: string; radial?: string; conic?: string; angle?: string; quickAngles?: string; stops?: string; hint?: string; position?: string; presets?: string; copy?: string; copied?: string; preview?: ((css: string) => string) | undefined; degrees?: ((angle: number) => string) | undefined; stop?: ((number: number, color: string) => string) | undefined; preset?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: `editor`, `preview(css)`, `type`, `linear`, `radial`, `conic`, `angle`, `degrees(n)`, `quickAngles`, `stops`, `stop(number, color)`, `hint`, `position`, `presets`, `preset(name)`, `copy`, `copied`.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#GradientEditor.tr: Gradyan düzenleyicisi: `<GradientEditor bind:value={$css} />`. Değer bir CSS gradyanıdır.

hadi-march/ui#Grid.name: Grid
hadi-march/ui#Grid.doc: Responsive grid that never overflows: fixed or auto columns, fill and balance the last row, equal row heights.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Columns 1–6 (default 2); collapses to 2 on tablets (4+ columns) and 1 on phones.

props.name: min
props.doc: Auto columns of at least this width ("16rem") instead of a fixed count.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Last row: "stretch" — its items share the row's remaining space equally; "last" — only the last item grows into it (with `cols`). Default: aligned columns with a gap at the end.

props.name: balance
props.doc: Pick the column count that spreads items evenly over the rows (5 in 4 columns → 3 + 2, not 4 + 1). CSS only.

props.name: minCol
props.doc: Narrowest column (default "9rem"): when the box is too narrow for `cols` of this width, fewer columns are used.

props.name: equal
props.doc: Every row as tall as the tallest, across the whole grid. With `cols` it combines with `fill` (span mode: the last row is filled AND all rows are equal). Cards in one row are always equal height.

hadi-march/ui#Grid.tr: Asla taşmayan duyarlı ızgara: sabit ya da otomatik sütunlar, son satırı doldurma ve dengeleme, eşit satır yükseklikleri.

hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.name: HADI_RING
hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.doc: The four HADİ colors: Heyecan, Aktivite, Dostluk, İletişim (a theme that defines its brand tokens wins).
hadi-march/ui#HADI_RING.tr: Dört HADİ rengi: Heyecan, Aktivite, Dostluk, İletişim (marka belirteçlerini tanımlayan tema önceliklidir).

hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.name: heartBurst
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.doc: Throws a particle burst (and a ring) from the center of `host` (give it position: relative).
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.signature: function heartBurst(host: HTMLElement, o: BurstOptions = {}): void
hadi-march/ui#heartBurst.tr: `host` merkezinden bir parçacık patlaması (ve halka) fırlatır (host'a position: relative verin).

hadi-march/ui#heartPop.name: heartPop
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.doc: Pops a heart: squash, overshoot, settle (on) or a small press (off).
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.signature: function heartPop(el: Element, on: boolean): void
hadi-march/ui#heartPop.tr: Kalbi zıplatır: sıkışma, aşma, yerleşme (açık) ya da küçük bir basış (kapalı).

hadi-march/ui#hsvToRgb.name: hsvToRgb
hadi-march/ui#hsvToRgb.doc: HSV(A) to RGB(A): h 0–360, s / v 0–1, r g b 0–255.

hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.name: htmlToMarkdown
hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.doc: HTML (a web page, an office suite, the clipboard) → Markdown, through the safe content core's allowlist.
hadi-march/ui#htmlToMarkdown.tr: HTML (web sayfası, ofis paketi, pano) → Markdown; güvenli içerik çekirdeğinin izin listesinden geçirilir.

hadi-march/ui#IconButton.name: IconButton
hadi-march/ui#IconButton.doc: Icon-only button. `label` is required (aria-label + tooltip title). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>` size: xs | sm | md | lg. variant: danger | solid | raised. `shape="round"`, `pressed` (toggle), `inverse` (on dark media), `href` (a link).

props.name: title
props.doc: The native tooltip: the label by default, your own text, or false for none.

props.name: shape
props.doc: `round`: a circle.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: A toggle button: sets `aria-pressed` and the shared pressed look (`is-pressed`). Leave unset for a plain button.

props.name: inverse
props.doc: On dark media (a photo, a video, a scrim): light icon, light hover and focus ring.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders a link that looks like the button: the router's Link inside the app, a plain `<a>` for an external address.

props.name: children
props.doc: Shown after the icon (alone when there is no icon): e.g. a count Badge, which sits on the corner.

hadi-march/ui#IconButton.tr: Yalnızca simgeli düğme. `label` zorunludur (aria-label + ipucu başlığı). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>`

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL (same origin, data: or blob:, so the canvas can read it).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Accessible description of the image.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: Fixed aspect (width / height); omitted: the aspect choices decide.

props.name: aspects
props.doc: Aspect choices (default free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:4, 9:16); false hides them.

props.name: maxZoom
props.doc: Highest zoom (default 4).

props.name: preview
props.doc: A live preview of the result (default true).

props.name: api
props.doc: Receives the cropper API.

props.name: grid
props.doc: The rule-of-thirds grid inside the frame (default true).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The key hint under the crop area (default true); when false it stays readable for screen readers.

props.name: tools
props.doc: The buttons: true (default), false, or the ones to keep.

props.name: sliders
props.doc: The sliders: true (default), false, or the ones to keep.

props.name: size
props.doc: The "640 × 480 px" caption under the preview (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { cropper?: string; area?: string; role?: string; hint?: string; free?: string; aspect?: string; rotateLeft?: string; rotateRight?: string; mirror?: string; reset?: string; zoom?: string; angle?: string; result?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one. `role` is the crop area's role description, `hint` the key hint.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#initials.name: initials
hadi-march/ui#initials.doc: Initials for a name ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), locale aware upper casing.
hadi-march/ui#initials.tr: Bir ad için baş harfler ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), dile uygun büyük harfe çevirme.

hadi-march/ui#inputFor.name: inputFor
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.doc: The component for a schema field (null for hidden fields).
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.tr: Bir şema alanının bileşeni (gizli alanlar için null).

hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.name: insertAfter
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.doc: Insert `value` after `p` (in an array) or after key `p` with `key` (in an object).
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.signature: function insertAfter(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, value: unknown, key?: string): unknown
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.tr: `value` değerini `p`'den sonra (dizide) ya da `key` ile `p` anahtarından sonra (nesnede) ekler.

hadi-march/ui#isAction.name: isAction
hadi-march/ui#isAction.doc: Is the value an action() object?
hadi-march/ui#isAction.signature: function isAction(v: unknown): v is Action

hadi-march/ui#isMac.name: isMac
hadi-march/ui#isMac.doc: True on Apple platforms (⌘ is the primary modifier).

hadi-march/ui#isPicture.name: isPicture
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.doc: True for a picture object (`{ src }`), false for a node or anything else.
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.signature: function isPicture(x: unknown): x is PictureSource
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.tr: Değer bir resim nesnesiyse (`{ src }`) true, düğüm ya da başka bir şeyse false döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.name: isSafeLink
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.doc: True for URLs safe to link: http(s), mailto, tel and relative ones (never javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.tr: Bağlantı için güvenli URL'lerde true: http(s), mailto, tel ve göreli olanlar (asla javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).

hadi-march/ui#isSep.name: isSep
hadi-march/ui#isSep.doc: Is this menu entry a separator ("-" or `{ separator: true }`)?
hadi-march/ui#isSep.signature: function isSep(it: MenuItem): it is "-" | { separator: true }
hadi-march/ui#isSep.tr: Bu menü girdisi bir ayraç mı ("-" ya da `{ separator: true }`)?

hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.name: itemVisible
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.doc: Is this menu entry shown for `args` (action guard, `hidden`, `can` permission)?
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.signature: function itemVisible(it: MenuItem, args: unknown[]): boolean
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.tr: Bu menü girdisi `args` için görünür mü (action koruması, `hidden`, `can` izni)?

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.name: JsonEditor
hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.doc: JSON editor with a text and a tree view: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Value: the parsed JSON (null when empty); while the text is invalid the raw string.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Extra check of the parsed value → message or null.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON Schema subset (see TreeEditor): problems are listed in the text view and marked on the tree rows.

props.name: indent
props.doc: Format indent (2).

props.name: tabIndent
props.doc: Tab inserts two spaces (default true).

props.name: mode
props.doc: First view (default "text").

props.name: modes
props.doc: Views offered (default text and tree); one hides the switcher.

props.name: expand
props.doc: Tree levels open at start (default 2).

props.name: format
props.doc: The Format button under the text (default true).

props.name: status
props.doc: The "Valid JSON" confirmation under the text (default true). Problems are shown either way.

props.name: labels
props.type: { text?: string; tree?: string; view?: string; treeName?: string; fixFirst?: string; valid?: string; format?: string; invalid?: ((line: number | null, column: number | null, message: string) => string) | undefined; more?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: the two views (`text`, `tree`), the switcher's name (`view`), the tree's name (`treeName`), the tooltip of the tree tab while the text is broken (`fixFirst`), `valid`, `format`, `invalid(line, column, message)` and `more(count)` ("+2 more" after the first schema problem).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.tr: Metin ve ağaç görünümlü JSON düzenleyicisi: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Değer: ayrıştırılmış JSON (boşken null); metin geçersizken ham dize.

hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.name: jsxCompleter
hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.doc: `complete` for a `<Tag …>`: `jsxCompleter({ tag: "Button", props: [{ name: "variant", values: ["primary", "ghost"] }, { name: "icon", value: "={plus}" }] })`. `props` may be an accessor (the list can change). Without `tag` any opening tag is completed.
hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.signature: function jsxCompleter(o: { tag?: string | (() => string); props: readonly JsxProp[] | (() => readonly JsxProp[]) }): (ctx: CodeCompleteContext) => CodeCompletion | null

params.name: o
params.type: { tag?: string | (() => string); props: readonly JsxProp[] | (() => readonly JsxProp[]) }

hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.tr: CodeEditor için bir JSX etiketinin hazır `complete` işlevi: özellik adlarını ve tırnak içinde değerlerini önerir: `jsxCompleter({ tag: "Button", props: [{ name: "variant", values: ["primary", "ghost"] }] })`.

hadi-march/ui#key.name: key
hadi-march/ui#key.doc: Register a global shortcut. Returns an unregister function (also called automatically with the current owner). `combo` e.g. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" sequences are not supported; single chords only).
hadi-march/ui#key.signature: function key(combo: string, fn: (e: KeyboardEvent) => unknown, opts: KeyOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/ui#key.tr: Genel kısayol kaydeder. Kaydı kaldıran bir işlev döndürür (mevcut sahip ile otomatik de çağrılır). `combo` örn. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" dizileri desteklenmez; yalnızca tek tuş birleşimleri).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.name: KeyframeTimeline

props.name: renderTarget
props.doc: Draws a preview target (default: a labelled pill in the track's color).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Snap step in ms (default 50; 0 turns snapping off).

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Start playing when shown (default false).

props.name: loop
props.doc: Loop (default true).

props.name: stage
props.doc: Preview stage over the lanes (default true).

props.name: transport
props.doc: The playback bar: true (default), false, or the parts to keep. Space still plays and pauses.

props.name: speeds
props.doc: Speed choices (default 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2).

props.name: inspector
props.doc: The keyframe inspector under the lanes: time, value, delete, easing (default true).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The text shown in the inspector's place while no keyframe is selected (default true).

props.name: curves
props.doc: The value curve drawn in every lane (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { timeline?: string; playback?: string; play?: string; pause?: string; start?: string; loop?: string; speed?: string; playhead?: string; hint?: string; time?: string; value?: string; remove?: string; easing?: string; keyframe?: ((number: number, target: string, prop: string) => string) | undefined; lane?: ((target: string, prop: string) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: `timeline`, `playback`, `play`, `pause`, `start`, `loop`, `speed`, `playhead`, `hint`, `time`, `value`, `remove`, `easing`, `keyframe(number, target, prop)`, `lane(target, prop)`.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.tr: Anahtar kare zaman çizelgesi düzenleyicisi: `<KeyframeTimeline bind:value={$timeline} />`.

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.name: KeyValueEditor
hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.doc: Edit an object of string → string (or number with `numbers`). Rows keep their order; empty keys are skipped; duplicate keys are flagged. Props: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (numeric-looking values become numbers).

props.name: numbers
props.doc: Numeric-looking values become numbers.

props.name: labels
props.type: { key?: string | undefined; value?: string | undefined; remove?: string | undefined; add?: unknown; duplicate?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: `key` / `value` (accessible names and default placeholders), `remove`, `add` ("Add row"), `duplicate` ("Duplicate key").

props.name: removable
props.doc: The remove button of a row: `false` removes it.

props.name: addable
props.doc: The "Add row" button: `false` removes it.

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: Content of the remove button instead of the "×" icon (a node, text or `() => node`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.tr: Dize → dize (`numbers` ile sayı) nesnesini düzenler. Satırlar sırasını korur; boş anahtarlar atlanır; yinelenen anahtarlar işaretlenir. Prop'lar: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (sayıya benzeyen değerler sayı olur) ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#Layout.name: Layout
hadi-march/ui#Layout.doc: The default Layout: back-to-top and route focus on. `features={{ scrollToTop: false }}` turns one off.
hadi-march/ui#Layout.tr: Değiştirilebilir sayfa iskeleti: adlı bölgeler, köşe denetimleri ve özellikler (başa dön, okuma çubuğu, rota odağı…); `.extend` ile türetilir.
